svg.aria-label: The 5800X3D to 9800X3D upgrade decision in 2026. TechPowerUp's resolution sweep on an RTX 4090 shows the 9800X3D is 29 percent faster at 720p, 17.9 percent at 1080p, 9.1 percent at 1440p, and only 2.1 percent at 4K; 1 percent lows are 20.7 percent better at 1080p but only 2.8 percent better at 4K. The widely-quoted 42 percent figure is a 720p number, and two reputable sites disagree by about two times at 1080p. The platform cost is 444.99 dollars for the CPU, 175.99 dollars for a B650 motherboard and about 400 to 470 dollars for a 32GB DDR5-6000 kit, roughly 1020 to 1090 dollars total, which means the memory costs about as much as the CPU. AMD relaunched the 5800X3D as a 10th Anniversary Edition in June 2026 at 349 dollars, so it is not discontinued.
svg.text: 5800X3D → 9800X3D: the honest 2026 math
The gap collapses with resolution — and it is a platform migration, not a CPU swap.
Correction: the 5800X3D is NOT discontinued
AMD relaunched it as a 10th Anniversary Edition, on sale from June 25 2026 at $349. It sells new today.
How much faster is the 9800X3D? Depends entirely on resolution

The “42% faster” number you keep seeing is a 720p figure. At 1080p two reputable sites disagree by ~2×:
TechPowerUp +17.9% vs TechSpot +38.5% — same GPU class, same day. Game choice is the result in CPU testing.
Buy it for 1% lows, not average FPS
— a wider gap than the average-FPS gain.
At 4K the same measure is +2.8%. Noise.
The RAM rivals the CPU for cost
≈ $1,020–$1,090 total, before selling your AM4 parts.
Amazon US, verified 2026-07-25. A new 5800X3D is $346.81.
The five-minute test that beats any chart: watch GPU utilisation in the games you actually play
Pinned at 95–100% → the GPU is your limit; spend there instead. · Sitting at 60–70% while you miss your refresh → the CPU is holding you back.
Benchmarks: TechPowerUp + TechSpot 9800X3D reviews (RTX 4090, 2024-11-06). Prices: live Amazon US listings, 2026-07-25, new standalone parts only.
Genre and upscaling notes in the article are community-reported experience, labelled as such — not measurements we made. TechFuelHQ.
